summary: Ship the worktree guard schema and error document to adopters

delivery.outcome: An adopter that hits GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP receives the document that explains it, and the guard's YAML has a schema again
nonGoals: No change to the overlap checker itself
No adoption lock regeneration beyond the new managed file

architecture.decision: ticket-092 shipped the guard but stopped at the 9-file policy limit, leaving two loose ends recorded in its changelog. error/GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP.md was the only document under error/ that package-manifest.json did not ship, so the catalog entries had to carry documentation: null - tests/adoption-lock.test.sh requires every non-null documentation path to exist inside an adopter's .governance/. Shipping the file first and pointing the catalog at it second is the only order that keeps that test true.
architecture.rollback: Remove the manifest entry and set the three documentation fields back to null

validation.evidence: A built adopter contains .governance/error/GOV-WORKTREE-OVERLAP.md, so the three catalog entries may reference it
The diagnostic catalog still registers every emitted code
worktree-guard.yaml has a schema again and it parses
